split_unit: complete run seed; calibration seeds [606, 909] train, seed 1213 held out

metric_definitions.request_throughput_rps: server-completed requests in the measurement window divided by measurement seconds
metric_definitions.output_tokens_per_sec: API-visible generated output tokens in the measurement window divided by measurement seconds
metric_definitions.ttft: first API-visible token minus server receive time, filtered by first token time in the measurement window
metric_definitions.tpot: API-visible per-token intervals whose ending token is in the measurement window
metric_definitions.queue_and_kv: per-instance 50 ms last-observation carry-forward; instance means at each grid point
metric_definitions.censored: HTTP 499 is a drain-censored request, not a server failure
metric_definitions.migration_pause_stage: source pause start to request resumed at target
metric_definitions.migration_recovery: request resumed to first API-visible token after resume

versions.round2_v3: published Round 2 calibration replayed on these held-out measurement traces with the same empty phase-boundary state
versions.causal_rebuild: causal batch, Kaplan-Meier output, and migration models trained on seeds [606, 909]; closed-loop Llumnix routine Balanced/RemainingStepsLoad policy when mode is ON
versions.causal_fixed_replay: causal rebuild using held-out observed first-batch routes and migration start events; diagnostic replay only, not a prediction eligible for acceptance
